items.title: How does adding entry points compound the odds of a breach?
items.description: Assume every exposed endpoint (an API route, an upload handler, a webhook receiver) independently has some fixed probability of hiding an exploitable flaw — the same assumption behind the L3 chart's 3% default. Drag the number of endpoints and the per-endpoint risk to see how fast the probability that *at least one* is exploitable grows as a system's surface widens.
items.compute: const p = params.riskPerEndpoint / 100; const probAtLeastOne = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, params.numEndpoints); return { probAtLeastOne: Math.round(probAtLeastOne * 1000) / 10 };

outputs.label: P(at least one exploitable entry point)
